name: Mirova Coastline Rain Shell
description:
GLMZ's weather comes off the lakes hard — sideways rain, wind that finds gaps in everything, cold that drops fast. The Mirova Coastline is a rain shell built for the city's actual climate by a mid-sized outerwear label that operates out of a converted warehouse in the Tier 2 port district. The shell is a three-layer bonded nylon in muted slate blue, forest green, or the perennial seller, a dark burgundy that doesn't show grime. The hood packs into the collar, the cuffs seal with velcro tabs, and the front zip is covered by a snap-close storm flap. It is not a beautiful jacket. It is a jacket that keeps you dry.

The Coastline sells well across Tier 2 and Tier 3 because it costs a reasonable amount of money and does exactly what it claims. It's the jacket you grab when the weather app says seventy percent chance of precipitation and you don't want to ruin anything better. Students wear it. Commuters wear it. Street vendors who work outdoor stalls in the transit plazas wear it. Nobody notices you wearing it, which is sometimes exactly what you want.
what_it_says: You're practical. You checked the weather before you left.
story_hooks: A witness to a corponation security incident was wearing a dark burgundy Coastline — but so were at least forty other people in the same transit plaza that morning.
The Mirova warehouse has a secondary operation in its basement, and certain shell jackets come with an internal pocket that isn't in the official spec sheet.

A Tier 3 investigative journalist has been wearing the same Coastline for two years of fieldwork; the jacket has become a kind of talisman, and she refuses to replace it even though the left cuff seal is failing.

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian rain shell with a no-nonsense silhouette. Straight-cut, slightly boxy through the torso, with a modest length that hits at the hip. The packed hood creates a subtle bulge at the collar when stowed. Sleeves are straight and functional. Overall impression: dependable infrastructure masquerading as clothing.
physical_description.fit: Relaxed and deliberately un-tailored. Cut to accommodate layering beneath without excess fabric. Comfortable range of motion across shoulders. Cuffs taper slightly but don't constrict. Designed for quick on-and-off, not aesthetic fit.
physical_description.primary_material: Three-layer bonded nylon—outer weather-resistant shell, moisture-wicking middle layer, inner brushed lining. High denier count for durability.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly stiff outer nylon with a whisper-quiet finish. Brushed inner lining feels matte and soft against skin. Velcro tabs produce characteristic friction-sound when sealed.
physical_description.color_scheme: Slate blue, forest green, or dark burgundy (the most popular colorway). Muted, desaturated tones designed to hide water stains and urban grime. Charcoal zipper and black snap hardware.
physical_description.closures: Heavy-duty nylon front zip with a snap-close storm flap overlaying it. Velcro-sealed cuffs. Packable hood secured by collar snap-points when stowed.
distinctive_features: Hood packs entirely into the collar—no dangling fabric when compressed
Storm flap covers full zip run for extra water shedding
Sealed cuff system with dual velcro tabs for precision fit over gloved hands
Interior zippered pocket for small items
Welded seams throughout, no stitching that can leak
Subtle Mirova woven label on chest—understated branding
Reinforced stress points at shoulders and underarm
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2–3 functional. Mid-range pricing (roughly 240–280 Φ). Quality construction without luxury markers. Signals practical spending rather than aspirational consumption.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by commuters, students, outdoor market workers, delivery couriers, anyone who needs weather protection without drawing attention. Associated with the working middle of GLMZ—people who have money for good gear but not for fashion statements. Unmarked, unaugmented aesthetic.
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn in broke-in but maintained condition. Likely to show faint water spotting, small scuffs on the nylon, possible minor pilling on the inner lining from backpack friction. Velcro shows use but remains functional. Seams remain intact. Age measured in years of repeated use, not damage.
